rationale: Record that the visual-analysis Python install moves from an inline build.yml step into tools/ci/install_visual_python_deps.sh, which build.yml and the four sanitizer jobs now call, so visual-python-deps-present is answerable in every job that runs ctest. The installed set (tools/motion/visual/requirements.lock), its hash pinning, the configured-interpreter resolution, the wheelhouse path and the retries are unchanged byte for byte; the step test now runs the script and pins which jobs call it. pch_wiring_check also reads the Makefile generator's per-object PCH options. No visual harness fixture, golden, threshold, capture path, renderer, importer or Vellum-owned source changes, and no authority moves.
